title: University Name
answer: JIS University is a private university located at 81, Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, Kolkata, West Bengal - 700109, India.

title: University Address
answer: JIS University is located at 81, Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, Kolkata, West Bengal - 700109.

title: Main Building
answer: Most academic classrooms, laboratories and administrative offices are located in the Main Building.

title: Administrative Offices
answer: Admission Cell, Accounts Cell, Registrar Office and Placement Cell are located on the Ground Floor. Examination Cell and Library are located on the First Floor.

title: Engineering Department
answer: The School of Engineering and Technology offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with classrooms, laboratories, tutorial rooms, seminar halls and workshops.

title: Library
answer: The Central Library is located on the First Floor and provides books, journals, digital resources and reading facilities.

title: Placement Cell
answer: The Placement Cell assists students with internships, campus recruitment, placement drives and career guidance.

title: Examination Cell
answer: The Examination Cell handles examination forms, admit cards, results and examination-related support.

title: Admission Cell
answer: The Admission Cell provides admission guidance, application support and document verification.

title: Accounts Cell
answer: The Accounts Cell manages fee payment, receipts and other financial services.
